criterion.title: Allowlist Parsing
criterion.given: The HA_CONTROL_ALLOWLIST environment variable is set
criterion.then: The allowlist is parsed into a list of allowed entity patterns

criterion.title: Exact Match Allowlist
criterion.given: An entity ID "light.living_room" in the allowlist
criterion.when: A control request is made for "light.living_room"
criterion.then: The request is allowed and executed
criterion.testable: Control exact-match entity, verify success response

criterion.title: Wildcard Allowlist Support
criterion.when: A control request is made for "light.bedroom" or "light.kitchen"
criterion.then: The request is allowed for any entity in the "light" domain
criterion.testable: Control "light.any_room" with "light.*" in allowlist, verify success

criterion.title: Empty Allowlist Blocks All Control
criterion.given: HA_CONTROL_ALLOWLIST is empty or not set
criterion.then: The request returns FORBIDDEN error with message explaining all control is disabled
criterion.testable: Unset HA_CONTROL_ALLOWLIST, attempt control, verify FORBIDDEN

criterion.title: FORBIDDEN Error Includes Allowed Entities
criterion.given: An entity "light.bedroom" NOT in the allowlist
criterion.when: A control request is made for that entity
criterion.then: The error response includes the list of actually allowed entities
criterion.testable: Control non-allowed entity, verify error_message contains allowed list

criterion.title: Action to Service Mapping
criterion.given: Control actions (turn_on, turn_off, toggle, set_brightness, set_temperature, set_position, set_hvac_mode)
criterion.then: The action maps to the correct Home Assistant service call
criterion.testable: Test each action maps to correct POST /api/services/{domain}/{service}

criterion.title: Previous and New State in Response
criterion.then: The response includes previous_state (before action) and new_state (after action)
criterion.testable: Control a light, verify response has both state fields

criterion.title: Audit Logging for All Attempts
criterion.then: Structured logs include: tool_name, entity_id, action, allowed (true/false), duration_ms
criterion.testable: Check logs after allowed and denied requests, verify all fields present

criterion.title: Unit Tests for Allowlist and Control
criterion.then: All test cases pass with >90% code coverage
criterion.testable: Run pytest with coverage, verify threshold met

var.name: HA_CONTROL_ALLOWLIST
var.note: Comma-separated entity patterns. Empty = block all control.

constraints.constraint: NEVER bypass the allowlist check. Allowlist validation MUST occur BEFORE any API call to Home Assistant.
Empty allowlist (HA_CONTROL_ALLOWLIST="" or unset) MUST block ALL control operations with FORBIDDEN error.
All control attempts (allowed AND denied) MUST be logged with allowed=true/false field for audit trail.
Extend HomeAssistantClient from Story 16.1. Add call_service() method to existing class. Do not duplicate HTTP client logic.
Control response MUST include previous_state and new_state. Get state before call, get state after call.
Follow existing MCP tool patterns: async handler function, tool dict with name/description/inputSchema/handler, structured logging.
